subject: English
question_text: Nowadays we are living in the age of logic. One can easily
stimulus: practice it by attending in debate competition. Debating helps us to develop our logic and literary skill. Now, write a dialogue between you and your teacher about setting up a debating club in your school. 10 Subject Code :
guide_solution: Dialogue writing A dialogue between myself (Mizan) and the science teacher about to show a project in the science fair. Myself : May I come in, Sir? Teacher : Yes, come in. Why have you come? Myself : Sir, I have made a project and want to show it in the science fair. Would you want to see it sir?
